title: Create chatbot/memory/controls.py
description:
Create chatbot/memory/controls.py — the memory control operations module.

Implement the core logic for: pin/unpin a memory, delete a memory (soft/hard), edit a memory's content or metadata, mark a memory as private/temporary/permanent, do-not-remember (flag a turn to be excluded from memory extraction), remember-forever (flag a memory as immune to eviction), and correct-a-misunderstanding (update a memory based on user correction). Design clean functions that operate on memory records by ID and return results suitable for the API layer. Handle null provenance gracefully — memories created before this phase will lack provenance fields.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/memory/ (any existing modules) for patterns and imports
- chatbot/db/models.py for the memory model and how records are persisted

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/memory/controls.py exists and is a valid Python module
Module exports functions for pin, delete, edit, set privacy level, do-not-remember, remember-forever, correct-a-misunderstanding
Operations handle null/absent provenance fields without crashing
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: use SQLAlchemy queries over memory records
